scenario: An HR manager conducts a reduction-in-force (RIF) exercise by scoring all employees on retention value dimensions, cross-referencing each employee's payroll compliance cost exposure, and producing a ranked RIF candidate list for the executive team.
info_flow: afrexai-hiring-scorecard scores each employee on retention-value dimensions → afrexai-payroll-audit computes cost exposure per employee → reporting merges both outputs into a ranked RIF candidate list.
